svg.title: tyre_yard site plan
svg.text: tyre_yard · the tyre yard: the crew's first base (ch33–98)
Site plan in metres, north up. An old tyre-shop compound in Hapjeong-dong, Mapo-gu, between Yanghwa-ro and the river, inside hapjeong_gate_zone; 6 minutes' walk from
Hanbit Mart. No key and no script yet: everything here is decided here (beats ch33: "an old tyre-shop compound in a Mapo gate zone, with separate rooms").
SERVICE ROAD off Yanghwa-ro (Yanghwa-ro and the bridge approach 90 m north-west)
embankment: Gangbyeonbuk-ro and the river beyond (south)
1 Sliding gate, 7 m, on the service road: Grandpa waits here
2 The fence poster: NATIONAL GATE SKILLS EXHIBITION (ch47 hook).
3 Two-storey block: common room + kitchen, WC/shower and Sejin's
med corner below; five small rooms above.
4 Shed bay 1: Haein's workbench; the reservoir device is built
5 Shed bay 2: gear, relays, charging; the van bought with the
6 Shed bay 3: Orrin sleeps under the shed roof, not yet his
7 The container: Taeo's office and the crew room; door propped
8 The summon spot in the middle of the forecourt: Sera
9 Outdoor table and benches: Minho's cake (ch47); the fishing
co-op meeting with Grandma presiding and Orrin in the middle
10 Old tyre stacks left by the last tenant.
A from the gate looking south across the forecourt:
the block RIGHT, the shed LEFT, the container ahead.
B from the container door looking north to the gate
C from under the canopy looking south-west: the
Upstairs rooms: Taeo, Nib, then Sera (ch46), Kesh
• From ch33 to ch98, "the yard" and "the
container" in scripts mean this place.
• The forecourt is concrete with oil stains;
the street side is a block wall with a
• The river is behind the south fence: the
embankment road hum is the background
• ch99 moves the crew to the GO FIRST
building, two streets from Hanbit Mart.
